project_type: Go backend (net/http stdlib mux) + Next.js frontend (web/), PostgreSQL DB
build_system: Go modules (go.mod: module github.com/Autumn-27/artex). Frontend: Next.js (web/). No Makefile; use `go build ./...` for backend, `cd web && npm run build` for frontend.
test_framework: Go standard `testing` package + testify-style table tests. Run with `go test ./...` from workspace root. Many tests require a live Postgres DB (skipped when DB env absent).
test_command: go test ./... (skips DB tests when ARTEX_TEST_DB not set)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `go build ./...` from c:\apex\artex-ko — must produce no errors. 2. Run `go test ./agent/... ./db/... ./server/... ./report/... ./llmrec/... ./notify/...` — all non-DB unit tests must pass. 3. For DB tests, set ARTEX_TEST_DB=postgres://... and run `go test ./db/...`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: web/out/ is the pre-built Next.js static export embedded into the Go binary via server/webui_embed.go. It is NOT regenerated during Go builds; run `cd web && npm run build && npm run export` only when frontend changes are made.
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine. Never restart a running server unless asked. The DB schema uses `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` for idempotent migrations — always follow this pattern. go.mod module path: github.com/Autumn-27/artex.
contribution_requirements: 1. All new Go files in an existing package use the same package name. New packages under the module root must be named matching their directory (e.g. package memory in memory/). 2. HTTP error strings returned via writeErr() must be in Korean (as per existing constants in server/server.go). 3. DB migrations go in db/schema.sql with the idempotent IF NOT EXISTS / ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pattern. 4. Routes are registered in the mux.HandleFunc block in server/server.go (around line 765). 5. Agent prompts are Chinese in the internal reasoning body but output is Korean per the langDirective pattern. 6. Skill files go in skills/<name>/SKILL.md following the api-recon/SKILL.md frontmatter format.
key_patterns:
1. Route handlers: func (s *Server) handlerName(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request). 2. JSON responses: writeJSON(w, code, map[string]any{...}) and writeErr(w, code, msg). 3. DB access via s.m.pg (*db.DB). 4. llm_usage table in db/llm_usage.go has UsageByProfile(), TokenByModel(), UsageDaily() — rich aggregation already exists. 5. findings table: id, task_id, node_id, vulnclass, name, severity, summary, evidence, worker, asset_ids, status, report. 6. exploration_nodes payload JSONB holds finding fields (cvss_vector, cvss_score can go here). 7. The scheduler in server/scheduler.go drives periodic triggers via scheduler.step(). 8. Skill SKILL.md frontmatter: `---
name: <name>
description: <desc>
---`. 9. db.RecordFindingInput is what FindingRecorder.Record() accepts — defined in db package. 10. tasks table has schedule-related fields that can be extended (currently no cron/schedule column).
directory_structure: agent/ — all agent logic (planner, worker, main, retester, finding_recorder, tools, prompts). db/ — all PostgreSQL query functions + schema. server/ — HTTP handlers + scheduler + engine + manager. report/ — Markdown report renderer. llmrec/ — LLM call recorder/metering. llmpool/ — LLM failover pool. notify/ — notification channels. skills/ — skill SKILL.md directories loaded by the agent. detections/ — Sigma/Suricata rule files. web/ — Next.js frontend (pre-built, embedded). .agents/tasks/ — workflow artifacts.
